blurb: Lang Vineyards is one of the oldest family estate wineries on the Naramata Bench, celebrating 35 years of crafting quality wines. Founded by Guenther Lang, it was the first Farm Gate Vineyard in B.C. registered in 1990. The winery has grown from a garage operation to a renowned boutique winery.
